summary: @servicetitan/uikit-docs preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall script `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and uses that binary to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated blob (rotated string/constant array via a `WV8StW` shift-rotator, hex-named globals, `@bun-cjs` header) whose real behavior is concealed behind string-array indirection. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscator.io-style, using hex-mangled identifiers and an indirection object that wraps `execFileSync`, `readFileSync`, and hostname literals. The package advertises documentation content (`.mdx`) yet has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime; fetching Bun specifically to run a sibling script bypasses Node-based install-time scanners, and the obfuscated payload runs automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
